name: Inbox Choreography
summary: A flooded inbox triages itself in rhythm until one calm email from Pulse asks for a single decision, then inbox zero.
look: Warm, desktop-scale mail client with generous rows, a coral unread badge, teal auto-label chips and swipe-to-archive colour. The proof is one editorial reading pane with an Instrument Serif subject line; the payoff is an inbox-zero illustration built from the pulse mark.

motion.name: Row collapse
motion.how: height to 0, rows below slide up, 0.22 s power2.in, staggered on 1/16 notes

motion.name: Swipe triage
motion.how: x 0 to -100% with teal bleeding in, 0.25 s power3.in, one per beat

motion.name: Counter countdown
motion.how: 147 to 0 decelerating with expo.out over 2 bars

story: Hook: alerts, tickets and dashboard digests flood in while the badge climbs to 147: 'The email you needed was #147.' Reveal: the Acme Pulse row slams in at hero size and the rows beneath label, swipe and collapse. Proof: one email from Pulse, 'One anomaly, caught at 09:44', shows checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 and the human clicks Roll back #2231. CTA: inbox zero illustration, 'Caught before customers noticed.', lockup and Start free.
adapt: Turn the flood into the noise your customers drown in and make your product's one summary email carry the single decision it needs.

fit.risk: close to notification tropes; keep it desktop, typographic and slow in the proof beat
